story: Found by the eval in a simulated hey2, 2026-11-13, at the flake rate hey2 measured. #61 and #62 failed together on a good tree. The first round passed #61 alone, so it went back on the chain, in a candidate of its own. Then the second and third rounds failed #61 alone, both flakes, so the rounds started over with #61 the suspect and #62 let go. The queue stacked #62 on #61's candidate. That merge is the red candidate's own commit, so it was pushed under a new try, read back as one more attempt of the red candidate, not seen on the chain, and pushed again: six times in one tick, and again on every tick. A pull request whose merge here would be a red candidate still under test waits for that test.
